referee_caveats_inferred: The abstract says bolometric correction decreases with Lbol, whereas the main text and Summary say it increases.
Single-point infrared SED scaling leaves substantial template dependence beyond the tabulated flux errors.
A nonsignificant luminosity correlation does not by itself establish different long-term SMBH–host growth.
The correlation procedure does not state how X-ray upper limits or measurement errors enter the tests.
Only six X-ray detections constrain the average photon index; the quoted Γ–accretion interpretation is a comparison rather than a controlled separation of redshift and accretion rate.
